selection: Purposive six-case challenge batch from coded DAC 2026 descriptions outside the original 37 anchors; selected for mechanism boundaries, not representative sampling or independent falsification.

cases.mechanism: NotSoTiny uses evolving community hardware designs with deduplication, simulation and formal equivalence checks; its description reports harder tasks than prior benchmarks.
cases.qualification: Tool-grounded generation does not establish general capability if benchmark difficulty and contamination differ.
cases.next_evidence: Recover task-level results, held-out dates, contamination tests and equivalence assumptions; compare matched models and budgets.

cases.mechanism: The TierANNS title accompanies a description naming COGA: CXL-tailored priority queues, tiered placement and queue-hinted speculative index access.
cases.qualification: Memory-centric progress can come from host-side layout and access scheduling, not necessarily compute offload. The title/body system-name discrepancy remains unresolved.
cases.next_evidence: Resolve TierANNS/COGA identity and compare recall, working-set capacity, speculation traffic and host overhead against near-memory alternatives.

cases.mechanism: AvaTEE adds resource commitments to attestation and trusted runtime scheduling to address CPU denial of service; evaluation is described as FPGA-based.
cases.qualification: Confidentiality and integrity do not imply availability; security claims depend on scheduler trust and resource arbitration.
cases.next_evidence: Inspect adversary powers, trusted computing base, admission policy and contention workload before generalizing availability guarantees.

cases.mechanism: The described hybrid-bonded eFlash IMC prototype combines thermal modeling, differential programming and adaptive calibration to stabilize numerical behavior.
cases.qualification: Thermal management is an accuracy issue as well as a throughput issue; a reported tolerance is not zero accuracy loss or broad deployment proof.
cases.next_evidence: Separate ambient, die and programming temperature ranges; recover accuracy denominators, calibration cost and measured prototype conditions.

cases.mechanism: ChiSER guides chiplet accelerator search with an intra-core cost surrogate and rechecks top designs with a finer reference model.
cases.qualification: Reference-model rechecking supports a fidelity hierarchy, but is not independent silicon validation and can miss candidates excluded by surrogate misranking.
cases.next_evidence: Recover acquisition budget, rejected-candidate checks, ranking error, objective weights and reference-model calibration.

cases.mechanism: OpenACMv2 couples accuracy-constrained approximate DCiM architecture search with variation/PVT-aware transistor sizing and Monte Carlo evaluation.
cases.qualification: Representation and circuit approximation require an explicit error budget; nominal PPA alone is insufficient. Tool compatibility is not experimental reproduction.
cases.next_evidence: Recover task-level accuracy limits, error propagation, PVT/yield distributions and matched exact-arithmetic baselines.

limits: These are selected description-level interpretations, not independently accepted findings.
No new quantitative headline or rising/declining claim is accepted.
The cases qualify hypotheses; they do not establish historical growth, adoption or market outcomes.
